sloka: सम्प्राप्य ते महात्मानो राघवस्य निवेशनम् ।विष्टिताः प्रतिहारार्थं हुताशनसमप्रभाः ।वेदवेदाङ्गविदुषो नानाशास्त्रविशारदाः ।। ७.१.७ ॥
transliteration: samprāpya te mahātmāno rāghavasya niveśanam ।viṣṭitāḥ pratihārārthaṁ hutāśanasamaprabhāḥ ।vedavedāṅgaviduṣo nānāśāstraviśāradāḥ ।। 7.1.7 ॥

translations.english: Having arrived at Rama's palace, those great souls, shining like fire, knowledgeable in the Vedas, Vedangas, and various scriptures, stood at the gate as guards.
